name: Tsai YM timely opening-range breakout

source.title: Assessing the Profitability of Timely Opening Range Breakout on Index Futures Markets
source.source_markets: NQ and YM futures directly tested

session: Underlying US cash-market open to close; historical paper aligns to 09:30–16:00 America/New_York
mandatory_same_session_close: Close any open position at underlying cash-market close on that date.
max_entry_rule_origin: Selected research specification; one initial entry, no same-day re-entry. This cap is not an observed frequency.
observed_trade_frequency: NOT REPORTED for this exact selected specification

source_rules.indicator: Probe high/low from first 1 or 4 minutes; first later cross gives direction; exit at active-hours end.
source_rules.buy: After the four-minute opening probe, first price above the fixed probe high: buy once.
source_rules.sell_short: After the four-minute opening probe, first price below the fixed probe low: sell short once.
source_rules.exit: Close any open position at underlying cash-market close on that date.
source_rules.position_sizing: NOT SPECIFIED; one fixed contract for backtest is a proposal, not paper rule.
source_rules.cost_treatment: Author assumes 0.01% transaction cost per trade; not an exchange quote/fill model.

source_reported_performance: Author-reported YM 4-minute probe: 12.89% annual return after assumed cost, 2,677 transactions, p=0.15%; no independent untouched OOS.
source_sample: YM 2003–2013 in paper; probe minute optimized on full sample.
known_risks: Full-sample parameter selection, 1-minute fill sensitivity, no stop specified.
data_requirements: Dated one-minute US index futures OHLC and preferably bid/ask, accurate cash-session calendar and contract roll metadata.
proposed_adaptations_not_source_validate: First signal wins and no reversal/re-entry; choose next available executable price to avoid same-bar lookahead; use contract-specific tick/fee/slippage model. These are implementation choices.

research_score.meaning: Research priority judgment; not probability of profitability

evidence_status: Peer-reviewed; selected probe and assumed cost
special_case: First signal wins and no re-entry is a selected specification cap; source profit does not validate this implementation choice separately.
